what: When hovering a button (or a link or summary wrapping a button), the base (filled surface or 1px border) shrinks to .9× and fades out over .7s, while a hidden circle at the center (101% of the button width, blur 20px, .3×) clears its blur and spreads to 1× with a .6s expo-out, covering the button in the accent color. Text turns dark ink after .1s over .4s, and the arrow turns white after .1s over .5s. On release the circle fades along a .6s sine curve, blurring and shrinking

options.look: filled: Button filled with ink color (background is the contrast stage color), text goes from the contrast text color to ink color
options.--fx-bloom: Spreading circle color, default accent 65% + accent-soft
options.--fx-size: Circle diameter (share of button width), default 101% — 108% for square buttons, 103% for tall buttons
options.--fx-in · --fx-base-dur: Circle spread / background fade-out duration, default .6s · .7s
options.--fx-base · --fx-edge: Background color · border color, default transparent · ink 20%
options.--fx-ink-hover · --fx-icon-hover: Text and arrow color when raised, default dark ink · on-accent
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Icon whose color will change (if none, the svg right below)
options.Wrapped Link: Inside a·summary, it spreads even when the hand is over that link (the whole card) — place it on the arrow box at the card end

use: Job type

from.where: shared.css .gf-btn — header button·section-end button·FAQ arrow·pause-motion button
